prompt:
We have a bunch of informal notes about our clients, contacts, team members, and projects stored in our personal knowledge base under `/root/life/pkm/`. The problem is that all this valuable information is trapped in unstructured text — we can't run queries across it or spot things like missing contact details or broken cross-references.

We want to set up the full knowledge extraction pipeline so that:
1. It is properly configured to read from our notes vault and output structured data to the right locations.
2. It actually processes all our contact, client, team, and project notes to build the structured knowledge graph.
3. It produces a quality report (saved to a file called `weekly-feedback.md`) identifying exactly which people are missing email addresses, which project references are broken (mentioned in notes but have no dedicated project file), and any other structural issues.
4. A suggestions file (`suggestions.md`) is also generated listing actionable fixes.

The pipeline scripts are already available in the workspace. Please set it up end-to-end and run it so all outputs are persisted to disk.
